# The uv release CI installs, pinned by version and by the SHA-256 of every wheel PyPI serves
# for it. .github/workflows/ci.yml installs it with
#     python -m pip install --no-deps --only-binary :all: --require-hashes -r .github/requirements-uv.txt
# so a wheel whose bytes differ from these fails the install instead of running. It replaced
# `curl https://astral.sh/uv/<version>/install.sh | sh`, which ran whatever script that URL
# served, unchecked, and it keeps CI on GitHub-authored actions only (no astral-sh/setup-uv).
#
# The version is pinned so a new uv cannot change dependency resolution between two pushes of
# the same pyproject.toml. To bump it, copy the version and the sha256 of every bdist_wheel
# from https://pypi.org/pypi/uv/<version>/json: every wheel, not only Linux x86_64, so the same
# file installs on any runner or laptop. No sdist hash on purpose: --only-binary never builds.
# Hashes read from PyPI on 2026-09-23; `make ci-local` warns when the local uv is another version.
uv==0.11.14 \
    --hash=sha256:78411a883f230a710af19f2ac6e6f0ba8eae90f0e5af4605f923fd367539fff4 \
